Name: Blow-away Speed (Min)
Description: Level 5 reaction horizontal speed when the target's stats +0xC4 is 0; lerped toward Blow-away Speed (Max) as it approaches 1

Name: Blow-away Speed (Max)
Description: Level 5 reaction horizontal speed when the target's stats +0xC4 is 1

Name: Blow-away Launch Ratio
Description: Level 5 reaction upward speed = horizontal speed × this

Name: Berserk Power Bonus
Description: Added to a Strength-based hit's base power (Hit Parameters Damage Source 0) when the attacker has Berserk equipped and is in critical HP
